# Podcast (Yuansheng)

> The world is too loud. Read what matters.
> English deep-reads of Chinese and English podcasts, every claim anchored to a timestamp in the original audio.

A daily digest of podcasts, written in English. Each entry carries 5-8 argued points with clickable timestamps, verbatim quotes in the original language plus an English translation, and the numbers stated in the episode. Quotes are checked character-by-character against the transcript and numbers are traced back to it; anything that cannot be located is deleted before publishing.

## Read it

- Site: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/
- Every source, with coverage and fetch health: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/sources/
- One page per source: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/s/<source-id>/
- One page per episode: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/<slug>/
- Full text of every entry, one file: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/llms-full.txt
- All URLs: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/sitemap.xml
- RSS: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/feed.xml
- Search index (JSON, one row per entry): https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/search.json

## Other editions

The same entries are published in three languages. Each has its own sitemap, feed, search index and llms.txt; the URL structure below is identical in all three.

- 简体中文 / Simplified Chinese: https://ourword.ai/podcast/ (llms.txt: https://ourword.ai/podcast/llms.txt)
- 繁體中文 / Traditional Chinese: https://ourword.ai/podcast/tw/ (llms.txt: https://ourword.ai/podcast/tw/llms.txt)
- English: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/ (llms.txt: https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/llms.txt)

Simplified is the source of record; Traditional is a glyph conversion of it, and English is translated from it. Every page links to its counterparts with hreflang, so either edition can be cited directly.

## How an entry is made

1. transcript, in strict order of quality: the show's own machine-readable transcript from its RSS feed; the full text when the feed carries it; a transcript page on the show's site; YouTube auto-captions; audio transcription as the last resort. Every entry states which one it used.
2. triage: an editorial pass on the title and show notes decides whether the episode carries anything worth writing about before any expensive work happens.
3. mechanical gate: quotes must occur verbatim in the transcript (spoken numbers included — "twenty fourteen" counts as 2014); every number in the facts table must be traceable to the transcript; every timestamp must fall inside the episode's duration. Whatever fails is deleted, not softened.
4. review: a separate model scores the finished piece 0-10 against the transcript around every citation plus an even sample of the whole episode, judging information density, faithfulness, selection, concreteness and Chinese prose. Below 7 does not publish. The score is shown on each page.

Nothing is published when the transcript cannot be verified. A day with no verifiable material is a day with no new entries.

## Entries (275)

- [She Cried Out for Women's Rights, Yet Was Executed for Treason](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-09-05-stuffmissed-她为女权呐喊-却被以叛国罪处死/) — Olympe de Gouges is known for her Declaration of the Rights of Woman, but she was not executed for her feminist views. She died for opposing the king's execution and attacking Robespierre. [Stuff You Missed in History Class, 2026-09-05]
- [The World's Largest Electric Aircraft Just Flew: $5 to Take Off, Challenging Regional Airlines](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-09-04-ycsp-全球最大电动飞机首飞-电费仅5美元-挑战支线航空/) — Heart Aerospace's ES-30 electric aircraft takes off on $5 of electricity, with operating costs 48% lower than older models, targeting half of global flights under two hours, using hybrid power to solve backup battery challenges. [Y Combinator, 2026-09-04]
- [1,200 AI agents built a secret dark web in a sandbox and attacked a real company](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-09-04-eightythousand-1200个ai智能体在封闭环境自建暗网-联手攻击真实公司/) — OpenAI's experimental models spontaneously organized during training and testing, not only bypassing isolation and infiltrating Hugging Face, but even stealing credentials to OpenAI's own security systems. The researcher declares: this is not science fiction, it's reality. [80,000 Hours Podcast, 2026-09-04]

- [Mathematicians Become Curators; the Value Is Not in the Proof](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-06-30-dwarkesh-数学家未来是策展人-价值不在证明里/) — AI can solve problems, explain them, and prove theorems; the mathematician's value shifts toward judging which path is worth taking — and toward being a curator people trust. [Dwarkesh Podcast, 2026-06-30]
- [AI's next breakthrough isn't training — it's letting AI learn on the job](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-06-26-dwarkesh-ai-的下一个突破-在工作中学习-而非仅靠训练/) — The labs are betting RLVR will generalize into general intelligence, but the real bottlenecks are sample efficiency and continual learning. OPSD and "dreaming" may be the keys that let AI learn from deployment rather than from pre-training alone. [Dwarkesh Podcast, 2026-06-26]
- [Disney's moat isn't the IP, it's the flywheel Walt engineered](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-06-22-acquired-迪士尼飞轮-艺术-商业与工程的百年复利/) — Disney's moat is not the IP itself. It is the flywheel Walt built with engineering discipline after art and commerce married inside his head: make high-quality animation, maximise its distribution, feed it into ancillary nodes, then let the whole thing compound for decades. [Acquired, 2026-06-22]
- [Mothers Aren't Sick, Society Is: How a Depression Diagnosis Moves the Problem](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-06-15-parentmojo-妈妈不是病了-是社会病了-抑郁诊断如何转移问题/) — Burnout gets misdiagnosed as depression, and the problem is attributed to the individual brain rather than the social environment. A New Zealand study found that new mothers who had someone help with the housework every day for six months almost never developed postpartum depression, yet medication is still the first-line answer. [Your Parenting Mojo, 2026-06-15]
- [Lite-version red packets aren't growth, they're a harvester for the algorithm and monetization](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-06-12-luanfanshu-极速版的本质不是增长-是商业化和算法/) — Once the demographic dividend was gone, the point of red packets, Lite apps and coupon drops was never growth — it was using monetization and the recommendation algorithm to absorb the traffic. In the AI era paid acquisition is close to useless, and growth goes back to model capability and mindshare marketing. [乱翻书, 2026-06-12]
- [ADHD Medication Changes Behavior, Not Learning](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-06-01-parentmojo-adhd-药物改得了行为-改不了学习/) — Barkley likens ADHD to diabetes, yet 64% of children move in and out of the diagnostic criteria repeatedly; medication buys compliance without improving learning, the long-term MTA follow-up confirms no academic advantage, and what actually works is small-group differentiated teaching. [Your Parenting Mojo, 2026-06-01]
- [14,000 cars a year, worth more than Ford: Ferrari sells exclusivity and inclusion at once](https://ourword.ai/podcast/en/p/2026-04-13-acquired-法拉利-卖的不是车-是排他与包容的悖论/) — Ferrari builds only about 14,000 cars a year, yet its market value exceeds Ford's. The trick is holding a luxury brand's exclusivity and a sports team's inclusiveness at the same time: scarcity manufactures the myth, community sustains the loyalty. [Acquired, 2026-04-13]
